label: 墓园污染
parentStaticReview: Accepted full/native/terminal static phase review on 2026-10-20. Fixed soil and ground papers; clear low, tall, crest, settling poses.
actualCaveats: The four poses are strongly differentiated over only one third of a second. The initial left tip rises 357 source pixels (7.97 logical pixels) between frames 1 and 2, while frames 2 and 3 primarily broaden the crest. The cadence is not uniform and may feel abrupt at 12 fps.

The total alpha mass grows about 12.3%, then 25.8%, and drops about 26.7% at the settling frame. The last drop is an authored plume collapse, not a whole-frame opacity fade. It may read as a fast collapse.

The airborne paper cohort first appears in frame 2 and is separate from the two stationary ground papers. Do not claim those fixed ground papers lift or that every contour point follows a measured physical trajectory.

The final frame retains two low wisps, one detached remnant, falling papers and the soil. It is a nonblank terminal pose, not a seamless return to frame 1. No scene-removal time or 420 ms node lifetime is known without a consumer.

The material features are registered within 1 source pixel in the fixed-ROI search, and soil bounds vary by at most 2 source pixels (0.045 logical pixels). Their generated shading is not byte-identical, so subtle texture flicker remains possible.
At 32 pixels the smallest crest fragments and detached final remnant are subordinate, sometimes only a pixel. They read more clearly at 64 pixels. Browser and live runtime playback remain unobserved.
diagnosticTiming: Separate slow-diagnostic-repeat APNGs run at 3 fps and repeat for inspection; they are not the runtime contract.
browserReason: Known blocked browser/GPU environment reported by parent; no repeated escalation. Encoding and source-derived frames verified offline only.
